messages:
sai: quick idea — instead of only 'saved queries', what if Console had lightweight 'folders' for query/filters so teams can group per-feature or per-model views?
anya: +1. Designers: folders help surface context for non-power users. Need clear ownership and share settings. :thinking_face:
liam: curious about the backing model — are folders just tags on saved queries or a real resource with perms?
noah: prefer explicit folder resource. tags get messy with sharing and migrations. folders make it easier to enforce route-scoped defaults.
evie: telemetry question — if users run a folder (bulk run or quick-run), we need to attribute usage to both folder and underlying route/model for cost reporting. otherwise reports get misaligned.
sai: agree. requirement list: per-folder visibility (private/team/org), optional default route/model scope, quick-run/pin, and ability to roll out folder UI to a subset of org users for feedback.
anya: UX note — default folder for a route should be shown in the route header; allow pinning up to 3 quick filters.
liam: implementation note: we'll add endpoints: POST /api/v1/console/folders, GET /api/v1/console/folders?scope=route, PATCH /api/v1/console/folders/:id. payload sketch: ```json
{
  "name": "Customer Support Filters",
  "visibility": "team",
  "route_id": "route_abc123",
  "default_query_id": "q_987",
  "pinned": ["q_987","q_654"]
}
```
noah: backend needs to validate that route-scoped folders cannot reference queries outside the route unless visibility=org and owner is admin. also quotas: how many saved queries per folder and total per org? we have to surface quota usage in console.
evie: for telemetry events, propose: folder.view, folder.run, folder.bulk_run, folder.share with payload {folder_id, route_id, model_ids, user_role}. will support cost attribution.
sai: rollout UX — want a canary to 10% of orgs, then ramp. Need experiment flags at org level and a migration path for existing saved queries (auto-group by route into 'Uncategorized' folder).
anya: microcopy: when migrating show modal: "We created an 'Uncategorized' folder for your queries — move or create new folders" with CTA.
liam: front-end: folder list will be virtualized. add client-side caching and optimistic updates. Also add quick-run keyboard shortcut (K).
noah: storage: use existing metadata table, add folder_id FK to saved_queries. migrations: backfill NULL -> new folder per route if user has >3 queries? or keep flat and create one per user. we should discuss data migration safety in infra meeting.
sai: question for product: do we expose folders in shared dashboards? e.g., Console Analytics saved views should support 'folder scope' in exports.
evie: exports should include folder context. downstream analysts want grouping to correlate model latency/cost patterns to query families.
liam: accessibility: ensure keyboard nav and ARIA for folder tree and pin actions.
anya: link to quick mock: https://redwood.internal/designs/console/folders-v1 (internal)
sai: next actions: liam + noah to draft API + migration plan by EOD Thursday, anya to refine mocks, evie to write telemetry spec, i'll prep rollout checklist and experiment config.
noah: noted. also adding a small rate-limit for folder bulk-run API to prevent accidental high-cost runs (default 5 concurrent bulk runs per org).
liam: can deploy-bot add a deploy note when the API lands?
deploy-bot: noted — will post canary deploy notification to #eng-releases when endpoint is merged to main. :white_check_mark:
sai: cool — thanks all. i'll sync with ops about quota display in console before the API PR.
anya: leaving a comment in the mock about folder-level descriptions and owner field.
evie: i'll prepare a couple queries to use as telemetry smoke tests so we can validate cost attribution during the canary.
liam: will start a WIP branch and link here once branch exists.
sai: perfect — keeping this thread as the source of truth for scope.
